svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut five panels from 25 mm XPS with a fine saw or hot wire:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bottom and top 462 x 337; back 412 x 312;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: left and right 337 x 312 (337 front to back).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Right panel: Peltier cut-out 90 wide x 100 tall; three 20 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: port holes, a 12 mm drain hole and four 8 mm sleeve holes,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: all lined up with the shell holes (wall holes picture).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Left panel: 32 mm hole for the aerosol port.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Back panel: two 20 mm HEPA holes and two 32 mm gland holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: each panel lies flat on the shell, glued with foam-safe

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: adhesive (never solvent cement, which melts XPS); tape

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: every seam with foil tape. Front edges flush with the shell.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: no gap wider than 1 mm at any seam.
